craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Middle-opening shines; divine-vision shown; knowledge-formed kept. Rejected: (a) middle→center → killed: middle is the term. Read aloud: FROM the-MIDD-le's OPE-ning … IS-shown.

lines: From the middle's opening — and from bliss-knowing — it shines;
from its light, divine vision, knowledge-formed, is shown.
l4.sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāsāc ca cidānandāt prakāśate | tatprakāśād divyadṛṣṭir jñānarūpā vibhāvyate

reads_against.argmap: What shines from the middle's opening? → Middle-opening shines divine vision.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion
